findings.rootCause: Planner-time storage reads were not bound to the query's own snapshot lease. develop's TxnManager (GH-5970) admits 127 ordinary leases plus one reserved slot with a 30 s admission timeout; every default query already holds two ordinary leases (explicit + inferred LmdbSailDataset) while it plans, and branch-added planner code then took further leases on the same thread: TripleStore.repeatedVariableCardinality/exactCardinality/boundedDistinctCursorSkipCardinality/sampleTriplesStratified/indexCostProfile (ordinary), LmdbFiniteJoinSurfaceEstimator L131/L173/L369 and LmdbFilterSelectivityStats L690/L787/L1352 (ordinary createReadTxn), plus develop's own doWithPriority sites (page estimator, 5.3.2 sampler) that all queries share through the single reserved slot. Reproduced end-to-end in this repo: with only the query's dataset slots free and the reserved slot held elsewhere, 10 of 12 pressure cases stalled past 8 s at exactly those sites (cardinalityUsingPageEstimator:1916 via LmdbFilterSelectivityStats.expectedRuntimeRows and LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource.qualifiedIds, LmdbFiniteJoinSurfaceEstimator.estimate:369, TripleStore.repeatedVariableCardinality:1839 in frontier-OFF mode, TripleStore.sampleTriplesStratified:1507 via LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer), after which the IOException is swallowed and the estimate silently lost.
findings.change: Pinned planning read lease, as the design prescribes, with the critique's corrections. TxnManager: Txn gains a per-lease id (advanced on reuse), isLive(leaseId) (owned && !closed && !idle && same lease, under the Txn monitor: this is what makes a Mode.RESET pooled/recycled transaction detectable, since its handle stays live), isTracked(), and planningView(target) (a non-owning view that mirrors handle/version/value pool so LmdbRecordIterator cursors renew exactly like on the target; close() is a no-op, no permit); plus LongAdder admission counters and permit accessors for lease-accounting tests. TripleStore: ThreadLocal depth-counted pinPlanningTxn(Txn) (outermost pin wins; refuses null/foreign/untracked/non-live transactions; untracked refusal is the structural answer to the shared-cache poisoning critique: an untracked reader keeps its pre-commit snapshot while SHARED_*_CACHE keys assume every planning read sees the head, so LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh stays unpinned and could not pin even if it tried), livePinnedPlanningTxn() re-checks isLive on every use so a pin whose dataset was closed from any thread falls back instead of reading a recycled txn, planningReadTxn() (pinned view, else ordinary lease; only for reads that go through getTriples/LmdbRecordIterator, which lock and version-check per step), planningRead(callback) (pinned: run on pinned handle under lockManager.readLock(); unpinned: doWithPriority, i.e. develop behaviour) for short raw-handle reads, planningScan(callback) (unpinned: ordinary doWith, so a background sampler never occupies the reserved slot) for bounded scans, and planningRead(Txn, callback) for a caller-supplied transaction under the read lock. Converted sites: cardinalityUsingPageEstimator, both legacy-sampler callbacks, boundedExactCardinality, indexCostProfile -> planningRead; sampleTriplesStratified -> planningScan (plus a Txn-taking overload); repeatedVariableCardinality, exactCardinality(cap), boundedDistinctCursorSkipCardinality -> planningReadTxn (getTriples path). LmdbFiniteJoinSurfaceEstimator L131/L173/L369 -> planningReadTxn(), so the nested planningCardinality inside L369 reuses the same pinned txn and the self-deadlock is structurally impossible. LmdbFilterSelectivityStats: exactBoundedFilterZero and exactMatchingDistinctValues -> planningReadTxn(); sampleFilterPassRatio opens ONE planning txn and passes it to both the stratified pass (Txn overload, locked) and the prefix fallback, removing the second 30 s admission wait. Establishing the pin: LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.optimize wraps its whole body (request-bound optimizers incl. LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer, cascades, order/limit, uncached path) in try-with-resources on runtime.pinPlanningReads(txn), resolving the txn via SailDatasetTripleTermSource.unwrapDataset(LmdbPinnedReadTxnSource.class) -> LmdbSailDataset.pinnedReadTxn() (empty once closed). sail-base: SailDataset.unwrap(Class) default plus overrides in UnionSailDataset (dataset1 then dataset2; note dataset1 is the INFERRED member, harmless since both see the same env), DelegatingSailDataset (delegate) and SailDatasetImpl (derivedFrom: the pin is the committed base snapshot, the uncommitted Changeset is never consulted by planner storage reads, which is today's behaviour), and SailDatasetTripleTermSource.unwrapDataset. Deviation from the design, stated: the pin is NOT stored in LmdbEstimatorOptimizationScope/beginScope(Txn). Opening one estimator scope around the entire pipeline would have shared identity-keyed factor fingerprints across request-bound rewrites that mutate nodes in place (LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer currently owns a separate scope from cascades), so the pin is a TripleStore-level ThreadLocal independent of scope caching; LmdbCascadesOptimizer and LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh are untouched. Existing mock fixtures (LmdbExactFilterProbeCacheTest, LmdbFilterProbeScanCapTest) stub tripleStore.planningReadTxn(); no production signature used by other Mockito tests changed. Critique majors for this batch: #2 read-lock discipline (raw-handle reads only via planningRead/planningScan/planningRead(Txn,cb) under lockManager.readLock(); bare planningReadTxn() only for getTriples/LmdbRecordIterator paths); #3 Mode.RESET reuse (Txn.isLive(leaseId) with per-lease id advanced in reuse(), re-checked on every planning read; pin structurally nested in LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.optimize); #4 detached-refresh poisoning (pinPlanningTxn refuses untracked/view/non-live txns, LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh stays unpinned); #5 attribution (admission counters asserted, default and OFF modes). indexCostProfile (LmdbPhysicalCostObjective.loadProfile -> runtime.indexCostProfile -> TripleStore.indexCostProfile) now runs through planningRead and is part of pinnedPlannerReadsTakeNoNestedLease. This resumed run made no code changes: it verified the tree (staged diff identical to patches/wp8.patch) and completed the module unit suite and the LMDB ITs on the final tree.

crossWpNotes: sail-base (no WP owner listed): additive default method SailDataset.unwrap(Class) with overrides in UnionSailDataset/DelegatingSailDataset/SailDatasetImpl and SailDatasetTripleTermSource.unwrapDataset; japicmp should classify it as METHOD_NEW_DEFAULT (compatible). wp3/wp5 snapshot-identity plumbing (getSnapshotEpoch) now has a sibling lookup that returns the same dataset handle.

wp5 (frontier lifecycle / LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh): deliberately NOT pinned. TripleStore.pinPlanningTxn refuses untracked transactions, so detached-refresh estimates keep reading the committed head via the unpinned fallbacks and the revision-keyed shared caches cannot be poisoned by a pre-commit snapshot (critique major #4). If wp5 ever wants snapshot-consistent refresh estimates it must first key the shared caches on the txn snapshot instead of dataRevision.

wp1/wp3 (LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer and other request-bound optimizers): they are now covered by the pipeline-level pin without opening a shared estimator scope; the deviation from the design (pin not stored in LmdbEstimatorOptimizationScope) avoids sharing identity-keyed factor fingerprints across in-place rewrites.

Entry points that bypass LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline (LmdbEvaluationStatistics.beginQueryOptimizationScope from tests/other optimizers, LmdbEstimatorRuntime.exact*Surface with scope==null) still run unpinned: short reads fall back to doWithPriority (develop discipline), iterator reads to one ordinary lease. Critique minor #9 acknowledged, not eliminated.

Shared-infrastructure rule for wp2/wp6 future probes (critique major #2): a raw-handle read (direct cursors, mdb_stat) MUST be a planningRead/planningScan callback (read lock held for the whole callback); only reads that go through TripleStore.getTriples/LmdbRecordIterator may use a bare planningReadTxn() transaction.
LmdbStoreMultiRepoTest ENOSPC on this shared host is environmental; the integrator should expect it to pass on an idle machine (it needs ~800 POSIX named semaphores at once on Darwin).

The finite_binding_probe explain change from b1 (certified_bound_only/scalar_fallback instead of database_exact for sampled probes) stands; no golden test in the module or the ITs asserted the old label (final tree: 2205 unit tests with only the environmental LmdbStoreMultiRepoTest red; 144 ITs, whose 5 setup-phase environmental errors were green on isolated rerun).
